scenarios.title: Owned setup and independent oracle
scenarios.given: Unique Compose project and sandboxed browser
scenarios.when: Read every actual prepared snapshot, thread and finite SSE preview
scenarios.then: All evidence is public-parser admitted; failures before the first surface remain in the ledger

scenarios.title: Seven deliberate snapshots
scenarios.given: The real catalogue and ordered threads
scenarios.when: Select each state in PT and EN without following
scenarios.then: Question, state, times, steps, terminal reason and absent runtime facts match; no automatic stream

scenarios.title: Unsent local edits and recorded continuation
scenarios.when: Edit, restore, rephrase, change locale and explicitly read recorded continuation
scenarios.then: No mutation, private URL/storage/log payload or early result; original and recorded evidence stay distinct

scenarios.title: Read failure, cursor recovery and obsolete authority
scenarios.given: Real prepared bytes with bounded transport faults
scenarios.when: Retry a refused read, recover corrupt continuation, switch away from held reads
scenarios.then: Sanitized errors retain admitted evidence and use the cursor; obsolete authority cannot win

scenarios.title: Bilingual responsive confirmation and comparison
scenarios.given: Real awaiting and recorded completed evidence
scenarios.when: Keyboard-operate and capture 390/960/1440 PT/EN plus state variants
scenarios.then: Whole-page axe, 44px targets, focus, fonts and overflow pass with final source and runtime asset hashes

scenarios.title: Authored reference evidence
scenarios.given: Unmodified AskConfirm, DesktopAsk and States artboards
scenarios.when: Capture exact authored sizes on an owned Vite server
scenarios.then: Reference source, dependency and capture hashes are independent from production captures
